notes: First run on this repo (no prior ledger). The ui/ vitest config had no `coverage.include`, so v8 only reported files actually imported by a test (15 of 41 source files) and showed a misleading 99.5%; fixed vite.config.ts's coverage block to include all of src/**/*.{ts,tsx} (excluding tests/setup/main.tsx), which dropped the honest starting baseline to 220/370 (59.5%) stmts. Combined with the backend's unchanged 250/324 (77.2%), the true starting total was 470/694 = 67.7%. Added ui/src/actions/utils.test.ts (the fetch wrapper's get/post/put/delete, including the non-JSON-error-body fallback), ui/src/hooks/use-mousetrap.test.ts (bind/unbind/rebind lifecycle, mocking the mousetrap package), ui/src/shortcuts/KeyboardShortcuts.test.tsx (g h / g m navigate wiring), ui/src/pages/movies/list.test.tsx (loading/error/empty/populated states and the create-dialog toolbar button, rendered against the real DataTable), and ui/src/routes.test.tsx (route-param parsing for /movies/:id and /movies/:id/edit, exercising the real router and SideMenu layout). Also added a ResizeObserver stub to ui/src/test/setup.ts, since jsdom lacks it and SideMenu's react-resizable-panels needs it just to mount (react-resizable-panels was previously never exercised at all). No production code was changed. Rendering list.tsx and routes.tsx against the real component tree (rather than mocking child components) transitively covered several previously-0% shadcn primitives used by them: data-table.tsx, table.tsx, resizable.tsx, toast.tsx, toaster.tsx. Backend was left untouched: its two gaps (main.go's run(), which blocks on a real net.Listener and isn't worth the complexity of extracting a testable seam for a nightly run; and ui.go's Handler 'UI is built' branch, which the existing ui_test.go already documents as deliberately untested since dist/ only ever holds a build artifact) were judged lower value than the ui/ gap, which was larger and had a straightforward fix. All 8 existing ui/ test files and both test suites' pre-existing tests pass unmodified; 73/73 ui/ tests and all backend tests pass after this change. +16.0pp against the +15pp target, achieved within budget.
next_target: ui/src/components/ui/alert-dialog.tsx (27 stmts, 0%) is dead code - grep shows it's not imported anywhere in src/, so the highest-value next step there is deleting it, not testing it. Real remaining gaps: toast.tsx's dismiss/update/pause-on-hover branches (5 stmts) and toaster.tsx's empty-state render (1 stmt) need a test that drives useToast() directly rather than relying on transitive coverage; App.tsx (2 stmts) just needs a smoke-render test importing the real App component (routes.test.tsx covers routes.tsx's router directly but never mounts App itself). On the backend, cmd/movie-catalog/main.go's run() (44 stmts) is the largest remaining gap; testing it meaningfully would need refactoring it to accept an injectable listener/context instead of calling server.ListenAndServe() and os/signal.Notify directly - worth doing deliberately rather than in a nightly run.
